title: A refresh item's touches cover what factdiff.py detect writes, or detect writes none of it into the tree
goal: factdiff.py detect, run by a refresh item, writes its log and the _snapshots/*.txt files it rewrites either outside the tree (the scratch directory) or into paths planning puts in the item's touches, so a worker restores and moves no file by hand (both SP-qjg5r7jj refresh workers did: seven snapshots restored, factdiff-2026-10-12.csv moved to scratch)
